name: backup-unusable-but-reportable
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). B stops at 12 s and D's frames to A stop arriving (A hears nothing from D, but D still hears A). A's backup is unusable, so A enters no_route locally; its report can still reach C through D.
